reviews.rationale: Clause 5.1 is a one-sided ownership assertion by LICENSOR with no carve-out preserving the other party's background IP, unlike the policy that each party retains IP it owned or developed independently. It is silent on jointly developed IP and on any licence grant, so those protections may be absent from the contract. The clause confirms LICENSOR ownership of rights to be given, but does not address the other party's pre-existing rights.
